request: Scanning from an io.Reader finds every secret in the stream whatever chunking the reader uses, including a reader whose last Read returns the final bytes together with io.EOF (n > 0 and err == io.EOF): those bytes are scanned like any others.

defects.description: Published bug fixed upstream: fix(detect): handle EOF with bytes (#1472)

trigger.input:
printf %s '' | base64 -d > detect/reader_test.go
if go test -count=1 -run '^(TestDetectReader)$' ./detect >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo probe: pass; else echo probe: fail; fi

defects.why_missed: The project's own suite at the parent commit never exercised this input; the fix commit added the test that does.
